data.name: Mica
data.gender_notes: Mica is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word 'mikesh', meaning 'who is like God?', Mica is a name that signifies the preciousness and uniqueness of an individual. In the Bible, Mica is the name of several characters, including a mighty warrior and a prophet. The name Mica carries the meaning “Mine, precious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mica usually hope their child will grow to embody mine, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the divine spark within each of us.
data.etymology: Mica belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mine, precious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mica total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: מיקה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מיקה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ומשמעותו 'מי הוא כ אלוהים' או 'מיהו כ אלוהים', שם זה קשור לנביא מיכה בספר נביאים קטנים בתנך, שם שמשמעותו היא שאלה רטורית המביעה את הייחודיות של אלוהים ומדגישה את גדלותו וריבונותו על כל הבריאה.

in_greek.name: Μίκα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μίκα προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Τίς ὡς θεός' δηλαδή 'Ποιος είναι όπως ο Θεός;', αναφέρεται στον προφήτη Μιχαία από το βιβλίο των Μικαίων στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη, υπογραμμίζοντας τη μοναδικότητα και την ανώτατη δύναμη του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Mica
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Mica originem habet in lingua hebraica et significat 'Quis ut Deus' seu 'Quis est sicut Deus', nomen hoc conectitur cum propheta Micha in libro Prophetarum Minoribus Bibliae, quae quaestio rhetorica exprimit singularitatem Dei et magnificentiam eius ac dominationem super omnem creationem.

in_english.name: Mica
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mica is derived from the Hebrew language, meaning 'Who is like God?' or 'Gift from God'. It is associated with the prophet Micah from the Minor Prophets in the Old Testament. The name signifies a rhetorical question that highlights God's uniqueness, greatness, and sovereignty over all creation. In Christian tradition, Mica is used as a given name symbolizing humility, devotion, and the acknowledgment of God's supremacy.
